notes: Defect: promo code/discount amount is incorrectly displayed for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The return-trip code path in create-reservations.mappers.ts swaps from/to stations but likely does not adjust the discount amount for the return segment, and map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts passes the discount through without any return-trip awareness. Zero-amount orders (full promo coverage) flow through processZeroAmountOrderService which also does not distinguish return trips.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array) but supplied valuable technical context about the root cause: the return-trip code path in create-reservations.mappers.ts swaps from/to stations without adjusting the discount, map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts passes discount through without return-trip awareness, and processZeroAmountOrderService also lacks return-trip distinction. I built the full AC set from scratch based on that context. ACs cover: (1) core return-trip discount display fix, (2) one-way regression guard, (3) zero-amount order flow for return trips, (4-5) flat vs percentage promo code edge cases, (6) over-discount edge case, (7) no-promo baseline, (8) webhook data correctness, (9) sanitized dispatch payload correctness, (10) line-item modification correctness. Each AC targets an observable outcome without prescribing implementation.
